sections.content:
| Issue | Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|
| N+1 status filtering (3 locations) | High | Low |
| Pre-scan file once per refresh cycle | High | Medium |
| Sort key precomputation | Medium | Low |
| Unbounded `taskKanbanTouchedAt` growth | Medium | Low |
| Triple refresh per checkbox | Medium | Medium |
| Event listener cleanup via AbortController | Medium | Medium |
| Filter UI diff before re-render | Low | Low |
| Double rAF → single rAF | Low | Trivial |

Start with status filtering — it's in 3 places, mechanical fix, and affects every board render.
